wiktionary.gloss: The state or condition of being a man, as contrasted with being a boy, woman, girl, or nonbinary.

wiktionary.gloss: All of the men of a given place, area, or any human subgroup (ethnicity, nation, race, religion, family, work crew or ship's crew, etc.) regarded collectively.

examples: My goodness, James certainly is a prime example of manhood, isn't he?

wiktionary.gloss: The idealized nature of a man: all of the characteristics traditionally and ideally ascribed to manliness regarded collectively.

examples: The failure of William's business seems to have been quite damaging to his manhood.
I feel that when you boss me around, you insult my manhood.
wiktionary.gloss: The self-concept of a man being with respect to his possession of the various qualities traditionally and ideally ascribed to manliness; a man's sense or view of himself as being more or less manly.

examples: She spied on him in the shower and glimpsed his manhood.
wiktionary.gloss: The male genitalia, especially the penis.
